body:
S73 UPDATE — 2026-09-21

Status: OBSERVED (autonomous chain complete; closing review after docs commit)

Milestone:
AUTONOMOUS GAMEPLAY ACHIEVED via real input chain — no state injection,
no renderer bypass, no screenshot fabrication.

Controller (C1/C3 compliant):
* vision: rendered-frame pixel extraction ONLY (snake #FF4081, food
  #0000ff, 20x20 grid / 39px cells)
* actuator: 23 scheduled taps (x,y@frame) through the canonical
  TouchDispatcher DOWN/UP law pipeline (F-117 scheduled-input extension;
  all taps hit real button view ids 441-445)
* tap geometry: view_tree.json button centers (legitimate observable UI)

Results (per full run, 90 frames):
* 88 head-advance moves, 22 accepted direction turns
* 1 food capture: frame 34, snake grew 3->4 (cells px 3042->6084),
  food respawned (0,0)->(9,0) same render
* no game over during the autonomous session
* 3-run reproducibility: 3 independent full runs, per-frame PNG sha
  equality — 90/90 frames IDENTICAL x3 (determinism_proof.json)

C4 probes (real taps, app logic authoritative):
* reverse-direction guard: tap LEFT while moving RIGHT -> REJECTED
  (direction stayed R, heads (15,10)->(18,10))
* wall/wrap law: head (19,10) -> (0,10) — WRAPS, no wall death
* game over: engineered self-collision (head re-entry into occupied
  (5,10)) -> GAME-OVER OBSERVED frame 94 (panel -> game-over surface,
  1,868,783 non-white px)
* restart via START after game over: NOT OBSERVED (honest open —
  possible Dialog-based restart path, not exercised)
* deterministic timing: whole session byte-identical x3

Evidence:
* docs/evidence/s73_snake_autoplay/run_01..03/ (frames,
  gameplay_trace.json per C5 schema, SHA256SUMS)
* snake_autoplay.gif (39KB, real run_01 frames only)
* screenshot_metrics.json (B3 gate: 1080x1920; snake #ff4081 3042->6084
  px = length 2->4; food #0000ff 1521 px = 1 cell)
* determinism_proof.json + autoplay_summary.json

Regression: fixtures 25/25 rc=0 (zero f141-throws) on the current binary
(container rebuild + F-117 extension); corpus re-run completed; W4 legacy
recipe re-verified byte-identical (final frame pixel sha 1a419545419deb3a).

Remaining: canonical docs promotion (this commit), then closing review.

S73 CLOSING — 2026-09-21

Final status: OBSERVED → COMPLETED (autonomous gameplay chain proven end-to-end).
Exact completion criteria (PART C + FINAL SUCCESS CRITERIA): real APK ✓, real Activity ✓, real View ✓, real game loop ✓, real input ✓, autonomous controller ✓ (pixel-only vision + scheduled real taps; no state injection, no fake screenshot, no renderer bypass), real state transitions ✓, food interaction ✓ (capture + growth + respawn), multiple gameplay frames ✓ (90/run), real gameplay GIF ✓ (39KB, real frames only), trace ✓ (gameplay_trace.json C5 schema), three-run reproducibility ✓ (3/3 byte-identical, 90/90 frames per run).

Evidence paths: docs/evidence/s73_snake_autoplay/ (run_01..03, determinism_proof.json, screenshot_metrics.json, autoplay_summary.json); scripts/s73_snake_{controller,finalize,c4_probes,c4b_death_restart}.py.
Screenshot SHA(s): per-frame PNG sha256 in gameplay_trace.json + SHA256SUMS; key frames in screenshot_metrics.json (final frame pixel sha recorded per run; identical ×3).
State-change proof: START-growth tick (frame 2); food capture frame 34 (snake cells px 3042→6084 = len 3→4; food (0,0)→(9,0) respawn); turns observed cell-by-cell; game-over face at frame 94 in the C4b probe.
Reproducibility: 3 independent full runs of the identical 23-tap schedule — per-frame PNG sha equality across all 90 frames (determinism_proof.json: identical=true).
Regression result: fixtures 25/25 rc=0 (zero f141-throws); corpus re-run completed (per-app pixel faces in S73_REPORT §2); W4 legacy recipe re-verified byte-identical (1a419545419deb3a); zero regressions.
Relevant commit: 038f0be6 (S73 campaign; pushed and remote-verified).
Canonical documentation references: docs/evidence/S73/S73_REPORT.md; docs/ACHIEVEMENTS.md §0h; docs/ROADMAP_STATUS.md §1; docs/KNOWLEDGE_INDEX.md §0d; worklog.md S73-MAIN.

Honest residue (documented, not blockers to this objective): the app WRAPS at walls (observed (19,10)→(0,10)); restart via START after game-over was NOT observed (possible Dialog path, unexercised). Recorded in this issue's history.
